Cancel Shipments

Cancel a shipment before it leaves, as when the truck did not come or the customer changed the order.

Status
Not walked yet
Module
Warehousing
Length
5 steps
Updated
22 Oct 2026
Applies to
Infor LN

A task on its own, done beside the processes.

Note
Nobody has walked these steps in LN yet. Follow them as written, and expect a screen or a label to differ. Walk it to say, at each step, whether it matched.

Walk it

Steps

Screen
Warehousing➔Shipments➔Cancel Shipments whinh4230m500
StepActionYou should see
1check it can be cancelled: not confirmed, and no not-shipped quantity on it; a frozen shipment is reopened first
2select the shipment, one of its lines or its load, and choose Cancel on the Actions menu
3in the dialog, choose whether the goods go back to stock
4choose whether the order line is finalized, then continue
5a finalized order line reads Shipped, so shipping it later needs a new order line; left open, the same line gets a new shipment

Cancel Shipments

  1. Check it can be cancelled: not confirmed, and no not-shipped quantity on it

    A frozen shipment is reopened first

  2. Select the shipment, one of its lines or its load, and choose Cancel on the Actions menu

  3. In the dialog, choose whether the goods go back to stock

  4. Choose whether the order line is finalized, then continue

  5. A finalized order line reads Shipped, so shipping it later needs a new order line

    Left open, the same line gets a new shipment
